log.intro: Tap an adjacent tile to move. Reach the amber points.
log.resumed: You continue where you left off.
log.sepulchralCall: A chill runs through you: the mage calls the nearby undead.
log.levelMissing: The path continues, but nothing has been built beyond here yet.
over.winText: You leave the room with {gold} ◆ and your breath intact.
over.loseText: Darkness closes in. The room keeps its secrets.
set.title: Settings
log.hitFoeCrit.2: Precise strike! A critical hit leaves {name} at −{dmg}.
log.hitFoeCrit.3: Perfect impact! {name} takes {dmg} devastating damage.
log.hitHero.1: {name} hits you hard for {dmg} damage.
log.combatStart.1: Bones rattle! An enemy has spotted you.
log.combatStart.2: The air turns cold: someone else has entered combat.
log.combatStart.3: Careful! An enemy is closing in for the attack.
log.combatEnd.2: No enemies left standing. You walk on in peace.
log.combatEnd.3: The threat has passed... for now.
log.combatEnd.4: You lower your weapon: the immediate danger has faded.
log.heroDeath.2: Your story ends here, among the graves.
confirm.reset.title: Restart level?
confirm.reset.text: You'll lose your progress in this level and start over from the beginning.
confirm.quit.title: Quit the game?
confirm.quit.text: This will try to close this tab. If your browser blocks it, close it yourself to exit.
log.cantClose: Couldn't close automatically. Close the tab or app to exit.
ev.mausoleo2Ambush.title: Twin sigils
ev.mausoleo2Ambush.text: Two identical markings, carved on opposite sides of the chamber, pulse with a dim light as you approach. The air turns cold at once.
ev.mausoleo2Ambush.c0.r: The whole chamber comes alive! Spectres emerge from the shadows around you.
ev.mausoleo1GolemGuard.title: A pile of bones
ev.mausoleo1GolemGuard.text: A heap of bones and skulls sits beside a ring of fallen skeletons. As you approach, everything starts to shake.
ev.mausoleo1GolemGuard.c0.r: The bones rise all at once! A monstrosity looms among the skeletons surrounding it.
log.skillOutOfRange: Out of range for that skill.
log.bloodPactLifesteal: You recover {n} health from the killing blow.
log.circleHeal: Circle of Rebirth heals you for {n}.
log.circleWard: Circle of Rebirth keeps you from falling.
log.wildShapeEnd: You return to your normal form.
log.noEventYet: There doesn't seem to be anything here yet.
log.corpseTooFar: You need to get closer to the corpse to loot it.
loot.title: Loot
ev.palanca.title: Rusted lever
ev.palanca.text: It juts from the wall, half-sunk in rust. Something, somewhere, is waiting to be moved.
ev.palanca.c0.r: Something gives way in the distance. A coin pouch drops through a chute.
ev.orbe.title: Suspended orb
ev.orbe.text: It floats still above a pedestal, dust-free, as if time didn't dare touch it.
ev.orbe.hint: It casts no shadow. That's either a bad sign, or no sign at all.
ev.orbe.c0.r: A brief warmth runs up your arm. It feels good.
ev.orbe.c1.r: The orb resists, then yields. Costly, but it yields.
ev.orbe.c2.r: You leave it floating. Let someone else wonder why.
ev.mesa.title: Work table
ev.mesa.text: Rusted tools, a half-drawn map, and notes that mean nothing to anyone living anymore.
ev.mesa.hint: Someone spent hours here. Doesn't look like they left in a hurry.
ev.mesa.c0.r: Coins used as paperweights, hidden among the notes.
ev.mesa.c1.r: Whatever it was, it's not your business anymore.
ev.palanca1.title: Stone lever
ev.palanca1.hint: A stone mechanism, covered in lichen.
ev.palanca1.question: Do you want to pull the lever?
ev.palanca1.result: You pull the lever and hear a mechanism release somewhere. The sound comes from the crypts ahead of you…
ev.exit1.title: The cemetery gate
ev.exit1.hint: A great stone gate, left ajar.
ev.exit1.question: Leave towards the Crypt?
ev.exit2.title: The cemetery gate
ev.exit2.hint: A great stone gate, left ajar.
ev.exit2.question: Leave towards the Crypt?
ev.exit3.title: Entrance to the first mausoleum
ev.exit3.hint: A stone entrance, half covered in ivy.
ev.exit3.question: Enter the mausoleum?
ev.exit3.blockedHint: It's sealed. Some nearby mechanism might open it.
ev.exit4.title: Entrance to the second mausoleum
ev.exit4.hint: A stone entrance, half covered in ivy.
ev.exit4.question: Enter the mausoleum?
ev.exit4.blockedHint: It's sealed. Some nearby mechanism might open it.
ev.trampa.title: Unstable slab
ev.trampa.hint: Something about this floor doesn't sit right.
ev.trampa.text: The slab gives way under your weight and something fires from the wall.
ev.trampa.disarmQuestion: Want to try disarming it with your nonexistent expertise?
ev.trampa.disarmSuccess: More luck than skill: you take it apart without it going off.
ev.trampa.disarmFail: Your hand slips and the mechanism triggers. −{dmg}
ev.evento1.text: You hear strange noises coming from further ahead. A chill runs down your spine…
ev.tumba.title: Mossy headstone
ev.tumba.hint: An old grave covered in moss.
ev.tumba.text: The soil is loose and disturbed. Something glints among the roots.
ev.tumba.c0.r: A few old coins among the bones.
ev.cripta.title: Sealed door
ev.cripta.hint: A stone crypt with its door shut.
ev.cripta.text: The door is barred with rusted chains. It won't budge for now.
splash.title: What's new
skillshop.title: Choose your skills
skillshop.subtitle: Test system — spend your gold on the skills available.
confirm.finishShop.title: Finish and start the run?
confirm.finishShop.text: You won't be able to return to the skill shop until you restart the run.
confirm.resetShop.title: Reset skill progress?
confirm.resetShop.text: You'll lose every skill bought and gold will go back to 1000.
skill.butcher_precision.name: Butcher's Precision
skill.faith_strikes.name: Faith Strikes
skill.faith_strikes.desc: Melee physical damage has a chance to heal you for part of it.
skill.faith_strikes.tier1: 15% chance to heal 25% of melee damage dealt.
skill.faith_strikes.tier2: 30% chance to heal 25% of melee damage dealt.
skill.faith_strikes.tier3: 45% chance to heal 25% of melee damage dealt.
skill.flame_slash.name: Flame Slash
skill.flame_slash.desc: A weapon strike wrapped in fire that burns the enemy for a few turns after the hit.
skill.flame_slash.tier3: High fire damage, long burn, and some area around the target.
skill.iron_skin.name: Iron Skin
skill.iron_skin.desc: Permanently hardens the hero's skin, reducing physical damage taken.
skill.frost_arrow.name: Frost Arrow
skill.frost_arrow.desc: Fires a chilling arrow at range that briefly slows the enemy.
skill.frost_arrow.tier1: Low ice damage; slows for 1 turn.
skill.frost_arrow.tier2: More ice damage; slows for 2 turns.
skill.frost_arrow.tier3: High ice damage; slows for 2 turns and may fully freeze the target.
skill.poison_cloud.name: Poison Cloud
skill.poison_cloud.desc: Throws a vial that bursts into a toxic cloud, poisoning everything caught inside.
skill.poison_cloud.tier1: Light poison over a small area.
skill.poison_cloud.tier2: More poison and a bit more area.
skill.poison_cloud.tier3: Heavy poison over a large area, lasting more turns.
skill.holy_smite.name: Holy Smite
skill.holy_smite.desc: A melee strike charged with holy light, especially damaging to the undead.
skill.holy_smite.tier3: High holy damage, with a chance to briefly stun.
skill.war_cry.name: War Cry
skill.war_cry.desc: A roar that inspires courage: increases your own damage for a few turns.
skill.cat_reflexes.name: Cat Reflexes
skill.cat_reflexes.desc: Sharpens the hero's reflexes, increasing the chance to dodge attacks.
skill.bloodlust.name: Bloodlust
skill.bloodlust.desc: Every enemy defeated feeds the hero's fury, increasing damage for the rest of the fight.
skill.bloodlust.tier1: + light damage per kill (doesn't carry between fights).
skill.shadow_strike.name: Shadow Strike
skill.shadow_strike.desc: The rogue blinks next to the target and strikes before they can react.
skill.shadow_strike.tier2: +50% critical chance and a bit more damage.
skill.shadow_strike.tier3: Guaranteed critical the first time it's used each fight.
skill.lethal_instinct.name: Lethal Instinct
skill.lethal_instinct.desc: The weaker the prey, the deadlier the rogue's strike.
skill.arcane_chain.name: Arcane Chain
skill.arcane_chain.desc: A bolt of energy that jumps from enemy to enemy, losing some strength with each jump.
skill.arcane_chain.tier1: Hits the target and jumps to 1 nearby enemy at reduced damage.
skill.arcane_chain.tier2: Jumps to 2 enemies, less damage loss per jump.
skill.arcane_chain.tier3: Jumps to 3 enemies, almost no damage loss.
skill.arcane_overload.name: Arcane Overload
skill.arcane_overload.desc: Every so often, the mage's spell is free: it doesn't consume its cooldown.
skill.arcane_overload.tier1: 10% chance to not spend cooldown when casting an active.
skill.arcane_overload.tier3: 28% chance, and if it happens twice in a row it heals you a little.
skill.blood_pact.name: Blood Pact
skill.blood_pact.desc: The warlock pays with their own life to unleash a far more damaging attack than usual.
skill.blood_pact.tier1: Lose 10% of your current health, deal high shadow damage.
skill.blood_pact.tier2: Lose 8% of your current health, higher damage.
skill.blood_pact.tier3: Lose 6% of your current health, very high damage, and steal back some of that health if the blow kills.
skill.circle_of_rebirth.name: Circle of Rebirth
skill.circle_of_rebirth.desc: A ring of light that stabilizes whoever stands within its radius.
skill.circle_of_rebirth.tier1: Heals a moderate amount on cast.
skill.circle_of_rebirth.tier2: Heals more and keeps healing a little each round for 1 turn.
skill.circle_of_rebirth.tier3: Heals a lot, keeps healing for 2 turns, and prevents dying to a single hit once while it's active.
skill.watchful_grace.name: Watchful Grace
skill.watchful_grace.desc: A small shield rebuilds itself every turn as long as it doesn't fully break.
skill.watchful_grace.tier1: +5% of a shield that absorbs damage, renews every turn.
skill.watchful_grace.tier3: +15% shield, and if it survives a full turn without breaking, heals a bit extra.
skill.wild_shape.name: Wild Shape
skill.wild_shape.desc: The druid transforms into a beast for several turns, changing how they fight.
skill.wild_shape.tier1: 2 turns as a beast: +melee physical damage.
skill.wild_shape.tier2: 3 turns, +more physical damage and some armor.
skill.wild_shape.tier3: 4 turns, +high physical damage, armor, and heals a bit on hit.
skill.natural_symbiosis.name: Natural Symbiosis
skill.natural_symbiosis.desc: The druid recovers from the living environment of the dungeon.
skill.natural_symbiosis.tier1: Heals a small amount at the end of each turn if you took no damage that turn.
skill.natural_symbiosis.tier2: Heals more, and also if you took little damage.
skill.natural_symbiosis.tier3: Heals even more, and grants a small armor bonus while at full health.
skill.soul_harvest.name: Soul Harvest
skill.soul_harvest.desc: Every enemy that dies near the necromancer feeds their power, stacking through the fight.
skill.soul_harvest.tier1: +4% damage per nearby kill (doesn't carry between fights).
skill.soul_harvest.tier3: +10% per nearby kill, and at 5 stacks the next spell doesn't spend its cooldown.
skill.multi_shot.name: Multi Shot
skill.multi_shot.desc: Fires a volley of arrows that pierces through everything in a straight line in front of the hunter.
skill.multi_shot.tier1: Hits up to 2 enemies in a line, moderate damage.
skill.multi_shot.tier3: Up to 4 enemies, high damage, and slows everyone it hits for a turn.
altar.title: A candle-lit altar
altar.hint: A stone altar, ringed with lit candles.
altar.question: Do you want to bow before the altar?
altar.ev1.title: Healing light
altar.ev1.result: A warm light wraps around your body and closes every wound.
altar.ev2.title: Rain of gold
altar.ev2.result: Golden coins burst from the altar and fall at your feet.
altar.ev3.title: Blessing of strength
altar.ev3.result: Red fire runs through your arms. Your blows will hit harder for a while.
altar.ev4.title: Stoneskin blessing
altar.ev4.result: An unseen shell settles over your skin. You'll take hits better for a while.
altar.ev5.title: The all-seeing eye
altar.ev5.result: A violet eye opens above the altar and, for a moment, you see the whole dungeon around you.
altar.ev6.title: The altar strikes
altar.ev6.result: A dark surge runs through you before you can step back.
altar.ev7.title: Curse of weakness
altar.ev7.result: A grey chill runs down your arms. Your blows feel weaker.
altar.ev8.title: Hands in the shadow
altar.ev8.result: Shadow hands rise from the altar and snatch away some of your gold.
altar.ev9.title: Something wakes
altar.ev9.result: A dark crack opens beside the altar. Something has come out of it.
altar.ev10.title: Curse of frailty
altar.ev10.result: A brittle aura clings to your skin. The next hits will sting more.
log.altarSpent: The altar shows no power anymore.
chest.hint: A closed chest, covered in dust.
chest.title: A closed chest
chest.question: You approach the chest... do you try to open it?
chest.ev1.title: Abundant treasure
chest.ev1.result: More coins glimmer inside than you expected.
chest.ev2.title: Bag of coins
chest.ev2.result: A modest handful of gold, but gold all the same.
chest.ev3.title: Explorer's supplies
chest.ev3.result: Clean bandages and some loose coins tucked in the cloth.
chest.ev4.title: Empty chest
chest.ev4.result: Just dust and cobwebs. Someone beat you to it.
chest.ev5.title: Hidden sting
chest.ev5.result: Something sharp pricks your hand before you can pull it away.
chest.ev6.title: Noise in the dark
chest.ev6.result: The creak of the lid wakes something nearby.
log.golemExecute: The {name} finishes off the badly wounded victim in one blow and grows stronger from it.
log.golemStun: The {name} lands a heavy blow and leaves you stunned.
